messages.content: How would you respond to the following statement: I look forward to the future with hope and enthusiasm.
I would answer that I strongly disagree with that statement.
How would you respond to the following statement: I might as well give up because I can't make things better for myself.
I would answer that I strongly agree with that statement.
How would you respond to the following statement: When things are going badly, I am helped by knowing they can't stay that way forever.
I would answer that I strongly disagree with that statement.
How would you respond to the following statement: I can't imagine what my life would be like in 10 years.
I would answer that I strongly agree with that statement.
How would you respond to the following statement: I have enough time to accomplish the things I most want to do.
I would answer that I strongly disagree with that statement.
How would you respond to the following statement: In the future, I expect to succeed in what concerns me most.
I would answer that I strongly disagree with that statement.
How would you respond to the following statement: My future seems dark to me.
I would answer that I strongly agree with that statement.
How would you respond to the following statement: I expect to get more of the good things in life than the average person.
I would answer that I strongly disagree with that statement.
How would you respond to the following statement: I just don't get the breaks, and there's no reason to believe I will in the future.
I would answer that I strongly agree with that statement.
How would you respond to the following statement: My past experiences have prepared me well for my future.
I would answer that I strongly disagree with that statement.
How would you respond to the following statement: All I can see ahead of me is unpleasantness rather than pleasantness.
I would answer that I strongly agree with that statement.
How would you respond to the following statement: I don't expect to get what I really want.
I would answer that I strongly agree with that statement.
How would you respond to the following statement: When I look ahead to the future, I expect I will be happier than I am now.
I would answer that I strongly disagree with that statement.
How would you respond to the following statement: Things just won't work out the way I want them to.
I would answer that I strongly agree with that statement.
How would you respond to the following statement: I have great faith in the future.
I would answer that I strongly disagree with that statement.
How would you respond to the following statement: I never get what I want so it's foolish to want anything.
I would answer that I strongly agree with that statement.
How would you respond to the following statement: It is very unlikely that I will get any real satisfaction in the future.
I would answer that I strongly agree with that statement.
How would you respond to the following statement: The future seems vague and uncertain to me.
I would answer that I strongly agree with that statement.
How would you respond to the following statement: I can look forward to more good times than bad times.
I would answer that I strongly disagree with that statement.
How would you respond to the following statement: There's no use in really trying to get something I want because I probably won't get it.
I would answer that I strongly agree with that statement.
